summary: Marketing is pivoting to prioritize the Asia Star and Intelligent China programs with a China-first focus, while the knowledge website redesign advances with an editorial layout and the team resolves an Outlook lockout that has disrupted access.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is an Outlook account lockout caused by stale saved passwords across devices; the team must re-login everywhere and contact JSB to confirm backend unlock to restore email access. The major initiative is the marketing push for Asia Star and Intelligent China, where SEO target research, participant/CRM analysis, and conversion tracking setup are underway, with Berkeley as a potential third priority and US partnerships on hold. The knowledge website redesign is moving forward with a decision to keep the current look and feel, improve menu categorization, remove the standalone videos section, and incorporate Joseph's editorial-style layout; immediate next steps include a 30-minute feedback session, sharing the HTML inspiration file, and integrating BCI/BSI indices. Upcoming work includes the ESG report draft and Yili Group digitalization enquiry, while the AACSB 2027 Global Impact Award application has been approved to proceed.
